description: CPM sand bed (5 cm) in still water with an excess pore pressure of 700 Pa at the bottom (1.44 x the fluidisation pressure), seepage flow in the bed Q 69 1, Q 70
covers: CPM seepage: Laplace equation for the pore pressure in the bed (red-black SOR, Dirichlet from the fluid, excess pressure at the bottom)
CPM effective stress of the contact network with the seepage force, unloading of the jammed bed, heave of a fluidised bed
CPM pressure gradient at the parcels from the pore pressure next to and inside the bed
